items.title: Markets end higher in volatile week; rupee recovers from record low
items.description: The total market capitalisation of BSE-listed companies rose marginally by ₹1.79 lakh crore during the week. Among the gainers, Reliance Industries led the increase in market capitalisation, while ICICI Bank, State Bank of India, and Axis Bank witnessed a decline in their market capitalisation.

items.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq end higher, notch weekly gains after earnings-heavy week
items.description: The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 152.87 points, or 0.31%, to 49,499.27, the ​S&P 500 gained 21.11 points, or 0.29%, ​to 7,230.12 and the Nasdaq Composite gained ⁠222.13 points, or 0.89%, to 25,114.44.

items.title: S&P 500 is set for longest weekly rally since 2024
items.description: Oil fell on reports Iran delivered a new proposal to the US amid diplomatic efforts to turn a fragile ceasefire into lasting peace.

items.title: IndiGo, SpiceJet shares to remain in focus on Monday as aviation fuel prices kept unchanged for domestic carriers
items.description: State-owned Indian Oil Corporation said early on Friday that ATF prices for scheduled domestic airlines have not been revised, offering some relief to the sector.

items.title: FTSE 100 drops in thin trading as NatWest, AstraZeneca weigh
items.description: The FTSE 100 index was down 0.6% as of 12:52 p.m. in London. Most European markets were closed for Labor Day.
